details:
Q1: Which area of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) The clarify phase (`.github/workflows/ai-clarify.yml` and its prompt)
B) The plan, implement or review/autofix pipeline phases
C) The orchestrator (poll, waves, stall handling, integration-sync)
D) The validation harness, the memory system, or other tooling
E) Something else: I will name the exact files or workflows in the `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean here?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure: I will link the run, log or PR in the `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
B) Lower cost or runtime (fewer tokens, API calls or minutes)
C) More reliability (fewer stalls, retries or failed runs)
D) Clearer docs or messages for operators
E) A new feature or behaviour, which I will describe in the `/answer`
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A) A specific failing scenario, test or run now passes: I will name it in the `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
B) A measurable target, such as X% fewer tokens or Y fewer failures per week
C) Make the minimum safe improvement in the area chosen in Q1, with contract tests
